title: How to Use AI as a Thinking Partner Instead of a Shortcut
summary: A sample article about using AI to ask better questions, improve prompts, and turn English reading into practical thinking training.
content: The most useful way to use AI is not to ask it for a final answer immediately. A better pattern is to use it as a thinking partner. Start with a rough question, ask the model to identify hidden assumptions, then ask it to generate three alternative framings. For language learners, this process is especially useful because it turns English reading into active thinking practice. Instead of only translating an article, learners can ask AI to extract useful phrases, explain why a sentence is persuasive, and help them reuse the pattern in their own writing. The key is to build a repeatable workflow: read, question, reframe, translate, imitate, and apply.
